brief:
Settler militias killed an elderly Palestinian woman and injured six others, including family members, in an armed assault on civilian homes in al-Dyouk al-Tahta, west of Jericho, on Monday afternoon, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The attackers opened fire at homes and people in the surrounding area.

Israeli soldiers assaulted a photojournalist during the incident, according to the rights group's account of the November 16 attack.

title: Settlers kill elderly woman, wound six in Jericho attack
